title: GAARA SINAI, SEERA KUD’ANNAN
paragraphs: Kakhuu Waaqi Gumii isa ta Kakhuuti gale.

Jia lama, eegi worri Israeli lafa Misiri keesaa bahe, worri lafa aloo ta Sinai qubate. Waaqi isaani dubbate waan jed'eeni, “Waan atini worra Yakobo ka gosa Israelitini jettu, Isani yayu waan anini worra Misiri tolche isan baase agartani. Amma hojja isani qonqo tiyya d'ageetani wold'aqisa kiyya guuttani, isani nama kiyya ka nati aanu taatani, gosa lafa tana keesa jiru ch'ufa ira, Isani gumi qaaloleetifi gosa qulqullo naa taatani. “ Jennaani
Musani deeme jecha suni gumiiti hime, worri ch'ufti woligale , “Waan Aabbo Waaqi jed'e ch'ufa intolchina” jed'e.

Duuba Waaqi waan Musani jed’e, “Beeni, gara biyya d'aqi waan jettuuni, guyya lama ufi qulqulleesa, ato anini guyya sadeesso hindufin. Ufi eegad'a, gaara iyyaabatiina, waan gaara t'uqe, nama taanaani, hori taanaani, ka harkaani inqabanne ijeesani, waan fulaan sunini fula qulqulloo taatefi.”

Guyya sadeeso baldooni dumansaa gaara ira mullatte, angaasu argani, mandisule d'agayani, ammalle magalata lalabani d'aani. Aari gaara suni duuche, aari sunini aka aara boola faara iti gubani olbahe; jennaani gaari sunini aka jaba chochoe. Gumiini Israelii naate hollattee.
Duuba Musani gaara khore, Waaqi seera kudannan iti kenne waan jedheeni:
Waaqi seera heddu woraa kenne akka gumiin Israeli akka gumii Waaqa jiraattu.

Duuba nami ch'ufti sodaate hollate. Musani waan biyyaani jed'e, “Insodaatina; wonti akanatiifi Waaqi isani laalu d'ufe, aka isani isa sodaatani ch'ubbu intolchine, akkuma inni lafa Kanaaniti isan geesuni, yo achiin baatani kakhu tokolle waaqota Kanaani woliin inseenina.”

Bori iyaatee Musani fula sorio iti qalani hunda gaarati Waaqaa mid’aase, soorio Waaqaa baase. Musafi, iti aanan isa Yoshuaani, gaara gubaati deebiani, duuba Waaqi Musa dhakhaa lama ta khakhuu isaafi jiddu Israeelii iti kenne. Duumansi gaara douche, ulfinni Waaqa kha ibida ifsu gaara guute.
